content.text:
Extract all questions from the attached file(s).

Use your code interpreter to:
1. Read the PDF/DOCX file(s)
2. Extract all text content
3. Parse and identify individual questions
4. Structure them according to the schema

Files attached: Quiz_Compilation.pdf

Remember:
- Preserve all mathematical notation (use LaTeX format)
- Extract metadata (title, author, date, course) from headers
- Identify question types (multiple_choice vs open_ended)
- Multiple-choice questions must not be skipped
- For multiple choice, extract all options with their keys (A, B, C, D)
- Assign a theme to each question: life_science | engineering | everyday_activity | physics_abstract
- Set has_explicit_answer=true only if the correct answer is clearly marked

questions.source_raw: 10. An object can escape a planet with radius R and mass M at an escape speed given by 𝑣 =
questions.stem: An object can escape a planet with radius R and mass M at an escape speed given by 𝑣 = \sqrt{\frac{2GM}{R}}, where G is the universal gravitational constant. Based on this expression for escape speed, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: A heavier object requires a higher speed to escape from the planet.
A lighter object requires a lower speed to escape from the planet.
An object requires a higher speed to escape from a planet with smaller mass and a larger radius.
An object requires a higher speed to escape from a planet with greater mass and a smaller radius.
